verdict.rationale: SavvyCal publishes a first-party API reference that lists endpoints such as GET /v1/events, POST /v1/links/{link_id}/events and GET /v1/links/{link_id}/slots, along with documented auth schemes. Its docs say "To try it out on your own account, create a personal access token," but nothing shows an in-browser interactive console or runnable code examples, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request/response examples, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: List events GET /v1/events ... Cancel event POST /v1/events/{event_id}/cancel ... Create event POST /v1/links/{link_id}/events
To try it out on your own account, create a personal access token.
